metadata.title: SolidWorks CAD Sketch Operations — 2D parametric authoring layer
metadata.description: Parameter catalog for the SolidWorks 2D sketching environment. SolidWorks sketches are constraint-driven (DOF tracker enforces fully-defined / under-defined / over-defined state) and feed every solid feature (extrude / revolve / sweep / loft / cut) plus reference geometry (planes / axes). Catalog covers 22 operations spanning primitive geometry (line / centerline / circle / arc / spline / style_spline / polygon / rectangle / slot / ellipse / partial_ellipse / conic / point / text), constraints (smart_dimension across 10 modes + add_relation across 16 geometric relation types), and sketch modify ops (sketch_fillet / sketch_chamfer / trim_entities / extend_entities / offset_entities / mirror_entities). Bindings target SolidWorks API ISketchManager + IFeatureManager.InsertSketch (COM API), plus VBA macro and VSTA add-in execution surfaces.
metadata.source: SolidWorks 2024 API Help — Sketch; SolidWorks API Reference — ISketchManager.CreateLine / CreateCircle / CreateArc / etc.; Y14.5 dimensioning conventions for SmartDimension modes

commonTabs.description: Standard parameter tabs across SolidWorks sketch operations

LINE.description: Create a 2D line by two endpoints. Length and angle are derivable post-creation. Construction-geometry toggle converts to non-feature-affecting reference line.

parameters.name: Endpoint 1
parameters.description: Start point (X, Y) on the active sketch plane

parameters.name: Endpoint 2
parameters.description: End point (X, Y) on the active sketch plane

parameters.name: For Construction
parameters.description: Mark as construction geometry — visible in sketch but ignored by feature creation

parameters.name: Length
parameters.description: Computed line length, optionally constrained via SmartDimension

CENTERLINE.description: Create a centerline (axis of symmetry / revolution axis). Always construction geometry. Used as the axis input for Revolve features and as the mirror axis for Mirror Entities.

parameters.name: For Symmetry
parameters.description: Hint that this centerline is the symmetry axis for downstream Mirror Entities

CIRCLE.description: Create a circle by center+radius, perimeter (3-point), or 2-point/tangent variants. Mode parameter selects the construction method; required points adjust per mode.

parameters.name: Diameter
parameters.description: Alternative size input — synced to Radius

parameters.name: Perimeter Points
parameters.description: Array of 2 or 3 perimeter points (perimeter modes)

ARC.description: Create an arc by centerpoint+endpoints, tangent to existing entity, or 3-point. Reverse Direction toggles minor vs major arc when ambiguous.

SPLINE.description: Create a NURBS spline through a sequence of through-points. Tangency and curvature handles can be enabled at endpoints for G1/G2 continuity into adjacent geometry. Smoothing tolerance allows non-interpolating fits for noisy point sets.

parameters.name: Through Points
parameters.description: Ordered array of points the spline passes through

parameters.name: Tangency Control
parameters.description: Enable tangent vector handles at endpoints (G1)

parameters.name: End Tangent Direction
parameters.description: Optional tangent reference entity at endpoints

parameters.name: Closed
parameters.description: Close the spline back to its first through-point

STYLE_SPLINE.description: Create a style spline (Bezier-flavored or B-spline-flavored) by control polygon. Degree 3..5 controls smoothness vs local control trade-off. Style splines do not interpolate the control points; the curve lies inside the convex hull of the polygon.

parameters.name: Degree
parameters.description: Polynomial degree (3..5 for B-spline, fixed by control point count for Bezier)

parameters.name: Control Points
parameters.description: Ordered array of control polygon vertices

parameters.name: Tangency
parameters.description: Enable G1 tangent handles at endpoints

parameters.name: Curvature
parameters.description: Enable G2 curvature handles at endpoints

POLYGON.description: Create a regular N-sided polygon by center, diameter, and inscribed/circumscribed mode. Inscribed = vertices touch reference circle; Circumscribed = edge midpoints touch reference circle. Rotation angle orients the polygon relative to sketch X axis.

parameters.name: Rotation Angle
parameters.description: Rotation about center, 0 = first vertex on +X

RECTANGLE.description: Create a rectangle in one of 5 placement modes: corner (2 opposite corners), center (center+corner), 3-point corner, 3-point center, parallelogram (3 corners). Mode determines required input points and the resulting parametric constraints.

parameters.name: Corner 3
parameters.description: Third corner (3-point and parallelogram modes only)

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: Rectangle width — auto from corner picks

SLOT.description: Create a slot (rounded-end elongated shape) in one of 4 modes: centerpoint_straight (center + length + width), 3point_straight (3 points), centerpoint_arc (curved slot from arc center + radius), 3point_arc (3 points along arc). Construction toggle and add-dimensions toggle control downstream behavior.

ELLIPSE.description: Create a full ellipse by center + major axis endpoint + minor axis endpoint. Major and minor radii derive from the endpoints; eccentricity follows.

parameters.name: Major Axis Endpoint
parameters.description: End of major axis (defines orientation + length)

PARTIAL_ELLIPSE.description: Create a partial ellipse (elliptical arc) by center, major + minor axis endpoints, start angle, and end angle. Reverse Direction toggles which arc segment is kept.

CONIC.description: Create a conic section (parabola/ellipse/hyperbola) defined by start, end, apex (control vertex), and Rho parameter. Rho < 0.5 = ellipse, Rho = 0.5 = parabola, Rho > 0.5 = hyperbola. Used heavily in aerospace fairings and optical surfaces.

parameters.name: Apex
parameters.description: Apex (control vertex) — together with start/end defines the shoulder

parameters.name: Rho
parameters.description: Rho parameter: 0 < ρ < 0.5 ellipse, ρ = 0.5 parabola, 0.5 < ρ < 1 hyperbola

POINT.description: Insert a sketch point. Used as reference for parametric position, hole-pattern centers, dimension witness anchors, and curve-on-surface seeds.

parameters.name: Position
parameters.description: (X, Y) on sketch plane or pick on entity

TEXT.description: Create sketch text either on a curve (path mode — text follows the curve) or as a straight block. Font, size, and spacing are configurable; the resulting outline geometry can be extruded/cut as a feature.

SMART_DIMENSION.description: Add a parametric dimension using SolidWorks's auto-detect dimensioning. Mode controls which dimension type is applied (smart = infer from selection, or one of: horizontal / vertical / aligned / angular / radial / diametral / arc_length / baseline / ordinate / chamfer). Tolerance form supports limit/bilateral/symmetric/MIN/MAX/Fit/Fit-with-tolerance per ASME Y14.5.

parameters.name: Entity Selection
parameters.description: 1, 2, or 3 entities depending on mode (point-point, line, line-line, arc, etc.)

parameters.name: Witness Line Position
parameters.description: Where the witness line lands (XY position)

parameters.name: Override Value
parameters.description: Driven dimension value (drives the geometry instead of being driven by it)

ADD_RELATION.description: Apply a geometric relation between selected sketch entities. Relation type covers all 16 SolidWorks relation flavors: coincident, concentric, collinear, parallel, perpendicular, tangent, equal, equal_length, horizontal, vertical, midpoint, intersection, fix, symmetric, merge, pierce. Pierce relates a sketch point to a 3D edge passing through the sketch plane. Symmetric requires a centerline.

parameters.name: Selected Entities
parameters.description: Array of 1..N sketch entities to relate

parameters.name: Override Existing
parameters.description: Replace conflicting relations rather than failing

SKETCH_FILLET.description: Round one or more sketch corners with a constant radius. Optionally keeps the constraint network attached at the original corner (Keep Constrained Corners) so design intent survives.

parameters.name: Selected Vertices Or Lines
parameters.description: Vertex (single corner), or 2 lines forming a corner; multi-select supported

parameters.name: Radius
parameters.description: Fillet radius — applied to every selected corner

parameters.name: Keep Constrained Corners
parameters.description: Retain original corner constraints via virtual sharp

parameters.name: Apply To Multiple Corners
parameters.description: Run on every selected vertex/line-pair in one operation

parameters.name: Dimension Each Fillet
parameters.description: Auto-add a SmartDimension to each fillet arc

SKETCH_CHAMFER.description: Bevel one or more sketch corners. Three parameterizations: angle_distance (one distance + an angle), distance_distance (two independent distances), equal_distance (single distance applied symmetrically).

parameters.name: Distance 1
parameters.description: Distance along first leg (or symmetric distance for equal_distance)

parameters.name: Distance 2
parameters.description: Distance along second leg (distance_distance mode only)

parameters.name: Apply To Multiple
parameters.description: Run on every selected corner in one operation

TRIM_ENTITIES.description: Remove portions of sketch entities. Five modes: trim_to_closest (snip up to nearest intersection), corner (extend/trim two entities until they meet at a clean corner), power_trim (drag cursor through entities to slice), trim_inside (delete portions inside boundary), trim_outside (delete portions outside boundary).

parameters.name: Power Trim Cursor Path
parameters.description: Polyline that the cursor swept (power_trim mode only)

EXTEND_ENTITIES.description: Extend a sketch line/arc to the next intersection or to a specified boundary. Direction = auto chooses the nearest hit; forward/backward override the search direction.

parameters.name: Boundary
parameters.description: Optional explicit boundary; if unset, extend to nearest intersection

OFFSET_ENTITIES.description: Create a parallel offset of a chain of sketch entities at a specified distance. Side selector controls which side of the original the offset lands on. Add End Caps closes the offset back to the source for closed-shape offsets. Make Base Construction converts the source chain to construction geometry.

parameters.name: Add End Caps
parameters.description: Close the offset shape with arc/line caps

parameters.name: Make Base Construction
parameters.description: Demote source chain to construction geometry

MIRROR_ENTITIES.description: Mirror selected sketch entities about a centerline. Copy mode duplicates; Move mode flips in place. Add Symmetric Relation creates a live symmetric constraint so future edits to the original propagate to the mirror.

parameters.name: Mirror About Line
parameters.description: Centerline (or any line) to mirror across

parameters.name: Add Symmetric Relation
parameters.description: Insert live symmetric constraints between source and mirror
